title: Lattice
description: JSON Schema for a bounded lattice as data: a finite carrier together with binary meet and join tables, optionally designating bottom and top elements. Lattice axioms — idempotence, commutativity, associativity, absorption — are not expressible in JSON Schema and must be checked by a verifier.

carrier.description: The underlying set L as a finite array of distinct symbolic values.

meet.description: The binary operation ⊓ : L × L → L as a nested table; meet[a][b] is a ⊓ b.

join.description: The binary operation ⊔ : L × L → L; join[a][b] is a ⊔ b.

bottom.description: Optional bottom element ⊥ of L. When present, must satisfy ⊥ ≤ a for every a ∈ L (verifier-checked).

top.description: Optional top element ⊤ of L. When present, must satisfy a ≤ ⊤ for every a ∈ L (verifier-checked).
